    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Action
    Constants representing possible combat actions.
    AIController
    Controller for monster AI behavior during combat.
    Boss
    Represents a powerful monster with a unique quote.
    CombatEngine
    Manages the turn-based combat system between the player and monsters.
    ConsoleUI
    Utility class for managing the console user interface.
    Dialogue
    Represents a single piece of dialogue in a branching conversation.
    Dialogue.Choice
    Represents a player's choice within a dialogue.
    GameEngine
    The core engine of the game.
    GameState
    Represents the current state of the game, including the player, the world map, and the current location.
    InputUtil
    Utility class for handling user input from the console.
    InvalidMenuChoiceException
    Exception thrown when a user makes an invalid choice in a menu.
    InvalidSaveFormatException
    Exception thrown when a save file has an invalid format.
    Inventory
    Represents the player's inventory, managing a collection of items.
    Item
    Abstract base class for all items in the game.
    MapLoadException
    Exception thrown when there is an error loading the game map.
    Menu
    The main menu controller for the game.
    Monster
    Represents a monster that the player can encounter and fight.
    NPC
    Represents a Non-Player Character that the player can interact with through dialogue.
    Player
    Represents the player character in the game.
    Potion
    Represents a consumable potion that restores health to the player.
    QuestLog
    Manages the player's active and completed quests.
    RandomUtil
    Utility class for generating random numbers.
    Room
    Represents a single room or location in the game world.
    SaveManager
    Manages saving and loading the game state using JSON files.
    SaveNotFoundException
    Exception thrown when a requested save file cannot be found.
    SettingsManager
    Manages game settings such as difficulty and combat log visibility.
    Skill
    Represents a special ability that the player can learn and use in combat.
    Weapon
    Represents a weapon item that increases the player's attack power.
    WeightedBag<T>
    A generic collection that allows for weighted random selection of items.
    WorldMap
    Manages the collection of rooms that make up the game world.
